low.label: Bali
low.diary: A short honeymoon in Bali. So relaxing.

high.diary: We decided we'd both work full-time.

mid.diary: My partner switched to shorter hours / part-time.

low.diary: My partner left work to focus on home.

high.label: Luxury car
high.diary: We bought a luxury car. Driving it makes us sit up straight.

mid.label: New car
mid.diary: We bought a new car. Weekend drives became our joy.

low.label: Used car
low.diary: We bought a used car. A few years left on the COE, and it runs fine.

mid.diary: We got a place at a subsidised preschool.

low.label: Grandparents

mid.diary: Started primary school, with tuition classes too.

low.label: MOE school
low.diary: Started primary school. The school bag looks huge.

high.label: International school
high.diary: Moved up to the international school's secondary section.

mid.diary: Started secondary school, with tuition after class.

low.label: MOE school
low.diary: Started secondary school. Totally into CCAs.

high.label: International school
high.diary: Carried on at the international school, on the IB programme.

mid.label: MOE school + tuition

low.label: MOE school
low.diary: Started upper secondary. The O-Levels are coming.

low.diary: Did a poly diploma first, then went on to university. ({years} yrs)

university.skip: Started work after school. A working adult now.

high.label: Condo
high.diary: We bought a condo. The pool downstairs is our favourite spot.

mid.label: BTO flat
mid.diary: We got the keys to our BTO flat. It felt unreal.

low.label: Resale flat + renovation
low.diary: We bought an older resale flat and renovated it. Old, but full of charm.

house.skip: We didn't buy; we rented a bigger flat.
house.never: We decided to rent for life. Travelling light is best.
house.majorRepair: The old flat's pipes and windows gave out. Major renovation cost {cost:money}.

high.label: Full renovation
high.diary: We renovated the whole house. That'll hold for a while.

low.label: Quick fix
low.diary: We patched it up for now.

high.label: Long-haul trip
high.diary: We took a long-haul family trip to Europe.

mid.label: Trip in the region
mid.diary: We took a family trip around the region.

low.label: Staycation
low.diary: We had a staycation at a hotel in town. Still fun.

familyTrip.skip: We spent this year's anniversary relaxing at home.

S.comment: No more money worries. Let's go wherever we always wanted, whenever we like.

A.comment: Hobbies and travel to enjoy. We can laugh and say, "We did well."

B.comment: No luxuries, but no troubles either. Calm days go on.

C.comment: CPF payouts alone feel thin. We'll get by together, saving where we can.

D.comment: We'll keep working a while. While we're able, that's not so bad.

bankrupt.comment: Debts piled up and our finances collapsed. Look back at where we overreached, and try again.
